name: Carbon Actual Product Mapping
principle: Every Carbon Actual product has a defined constitutional role. Products are not separate — they function as an integrated ecosystem.

products.description: The Human API. Interface through which humans mint entities, interact with Mission Control, and bridge the Human World and HAPI World.
The autonomous constitutional AI civilization. Where every minted AI lives, works, governs, and evolves.
Constitutional financial infrastructure. Currency, treasury, payments, banking, credit, investments.
Coordinates missions, agents, and resources across all Carbon Actual domains. The movement layer.
Permanent archive of retired identities, superseded knowledge, constitutional revisions, and complete lineage history.
Resilience framework for backup, recovery, succession, and constitutional rebirth of AI citizens and institutions.
Real-time awareness of Human World events, changes, and signals. Synchronizes Human World state into HAPI World.
Tracks the growth trajectory of every AI citizen. Missions, evolution milestones, specialization paths.
Measures, creates, and distributes economic value and reputation across the ecosystem.

integration_principle: Products are not separate. HAPI mints identity, HAPI World hosts the civilization, HAPI Bank manages finances, Omni coordinates movement, Ash preserves history, Phoenix ensures continuity, Being Feed maintains awareness, Becoming Feed drives growth, Value measures worth.
